scope: Fixed controls on a frozen development discovery cohort; no rootwise oracle baseline.
sign_convention: Positive gain = baseline loss minus subject loss. Positive compute increment = subject costs more.
timing_scope: Cold process CPU and wall include constructor, menu setup, posterior updates, candidate/tail compilation, choice, execution and trace. Common file/graph preparation is separate. Physical clocks are logical replay clocks; computation does not shift boarding.
selection_contract: Static menus precede outcome inspection. Eligibility uses actual endpoint coverage and the observed own-arrival clock to require a message received before the decision. Root selection does not use realized policy loss or predicted advantage.

identical_history_warm.scope: Root0 only: same already computed history replayed with the same model/planner. This measures repeated-history reuse, not acceleration on new journeys.

limitations: Discovery dates were used for development; these are not independent confirmation estimates.
Loss means use scored pairs; all missing and unsupported runs remain in the fixed denominator.
Logical replay CPU comparisons do not establish real-time feasibility.
